text.text: Plan the offsite from one page: agenda by hour, logistics tasks with owners, a budget that shows variance, and who is coming. Check the budget and open tasks every Friday.
When: the three days starting 40 days from now
Theme: Shaping the next year together
These numbers update as you work. Use this page for the weekly check, then open the list behind any number to act on it.
Each chart groups your entries as shown; click a slice to see the entries behind it.
The lists below show only what needs attention now.
If a chart looks off, check that every entry is connected to the right person or item.
Everything you need before you set off.
Layers; evenings are cold by the sea
A short story or idea to share at dinner
The vans leave the studio at 7:30 on Day 1. Remote colleagues: your flight details are in the Attendees table.

cells.text: Share the route and a departure time the night before
Pick one stop; avoid unfamiliar places for dietary needs
Kick off within an hour of arrival

text.text: Collect dietary needs early. A single missed allergy is the one problem you cannot fix on the day.
Catering reads this page before ordering.
If your needs change, tell the head of people before Day 1.
Sending dietary needs to the caterer
Send the dietary table one week before, with counts per need and any allergies marked clearly. Ask the caterer to confirm in writing.
Send counts and allergies in writing
Ask for a labelled option at every meal
Confirm the final numbers two days before
